definitions.top1: Expected ID is first suggestion, or no suggestion when the label is empty / scored cases. Before is legacy Fuse; after is Vietnamese fallback ranking. Not automatic-answer accuracy.
definitions.candidateRecall8: Positive cases with an expected ID in retrieval top 8 / positive cases.
definitions.fallbackPrecision3: Correct suggestion slots / all emitted suggestion slots (micro precision over at most 3, not padded to 3).
definitions.falseSuggestionRate: Scored cases with at least one incorrect suggestion / all scored cases; conditional denominator also reported.
definitions.rejection: No suggestion for a negative case; clarification counts as safe abstention, not necessarily an out_of_scope API status.
definitions.latency: One measured local matcher + retrieval pass per sample after warmup; nearest-rank P50/P95; no DB/API/network latency.

protocol.selection: Grid tuned only on 21 scored old + 16 new tuning cases. Pick lowest threshold with zero false suggestions, then maximize recall: 0.78.
protocol.holdoutLimitation: Separate authored cases, not an external independently collected corpus. No threshold/synonym tuning on holdout results; later date-parser safety hardening did not change holdout counts.

lint.scope: All code/test/tooling files added or edited in 5C.3B

browserE2E.reason: UI response formatter/client and HTTP/service covered with offline mocks; no live server or Gemini calls.

databaseIntegration.reason: No separate MONGODB_TEST_URI; production knowledge inspected read-only only.
